[Section] Appendix ::: Knowledge Graph Rules
[source_id=30] We make no changes from the graph update rules used by BIBREF6. Candidate interactive objects are identified by performing part-of-speech tagging on the current observation, identifying singular and proper nouns as well as adjectives, and are then filtered by checking if they can be examined using the command $examine$ $OBJ$. Only the interactive objects not found in the inventory are linked to the node corresponding to the current room and the inventory items are linked to the “you” node. The only other rule applied uses the navigational actions performed by the agent to infer the relative positions of rooms, e.g. $\langle kitchen,down,cellar \rangle $ when the agent performs $go$ $down$ when in the kitchen to move to the cellar.
